name: 同能力实现直接引用 Port 允许通过
source:
import type { ContextCompressor } from '../port/context-compression.js';
export class DefaultContextCompressor implements ContextCompressor {}

name: 别名经过 public-api 多级转发仍解析到真实 Port
source:
import type { CompressionContract } from '../public-api.js';
export class DefaultContextCompressor implements CompressionContract {}

dependencies.pipeline/compression/public-api.ts: export type { PublicCompressor as CompressionContract } from './contracts.js';
dependencies.pipeline/compression/contracts.ts: export type { ContextCompressor as PublicCompressor } from './port/context-compression.js';

name: 同职责词但引用不同 Port 必须失败
source:
import type { ContextCompressor } from '../../other/port/context-compressor.js';
export class DefaultContextCompressor implements ContextCompressor {}

name: 未被 new 的生产类即使同角色后缀但来自不同能力也必须失败
source:
import type { OtherCompressor } from '../../other/port/other-compressor.js';
export class DefaultContextCompressor implements OtherCompressor {}

name: 实现无关能力接口必须失败
source:
import type { MessageHook } from '../../hook/port/message-hook.js';
export class DefaultContextCompressor implements MessageHook {}

name: 类型别名不能冒充真实接口
source:
import type { ContextCompressor } from '../port/context-compression.js';
export class DefaultContextCompressor implements ContextCompressor {}

name: composition 中无法追溯到接口的生产绑定必须失败
source:
import { LooseService } from './run/service/loose-service.js';
export function create(): object { return new LooseService(); }

name: 未被 composition 构造的生产类缺少 implements 也必须失败
